reviews.title: A good product deserves a good review.
reviews.comment:
HIGHLY IMPRESSED BY THIS CHASSIS.
I usually purchase the more premium chassis from the more known and premium manufacturers. However, wanting to give my old 9900k system a fresh look and a few upgrades (new AIO, RAM and GPU), being it's five years old, I didn't want to purchases an expensive case from the more known manufacturers. So in my search, I came across this Musetex NN8 of a hidden gem. $80 for a chassis with included 5 ARGB fans? Let's do it!
Though not as hefty as the "premium" brands, the build quality is solid. It has a premium look and premium feel without the premium price. The included ARGB fans look nice, move a lot of air and are quiet even at max speed. There's plenty of room for cable management and a lot of tie down points for zip ties or velcro straps.
Someone mentioned in the reviews they had issues fitting their full size ATX motherboard. I did not share that experience as mine fit like a glove and went in nicely and comfortably. The chassis supports up to five 2.5" SATA SSDs OR three 2.5" SATA SSDs with one 3.5" HDD. Usually with inexpensive chassis such as this one, it's a pain to build a PC as there are usually a lot of charp edges you could cut yourself with. Well not with this chassis. They definitely paid attention to detail, polished off the edges while doing it in a cost effective mannor.
Definitely a good chassis especially for budget builders or people wanting to freshen up their older/aging PCs.
Intel Core i9 9900k CPU
MSI Z390 Gaming Plus motherboard
32gb Kingston Renegade 3600mhz CL16 RAM
AMD Radeon RX6750XT (reference) GPU
Seasonic 620 watt PSU
Thermalright 240mm AIO
reviews.author: Michael Otero

reviews.title: Best Bang For Your Buck Case With 6 RBG Fans
reviews.comment: One of the best cases I've owned and for 80 bucks!? Its a steal! Very good case, light weight (easy to move around and maneuver as required), love the glass side, all 6 RGB fans work and keep the internal components cool. Went from having a water cooled CPU to air cooled and this case and its fan are delivering excellent cooling capabilities. Love all the cable management areas and SSD/HDD mounting points, you should have no issue with space for storage devices; note, if your PSU is not modular and you have a clump of left over power cables, you may have to remove the bottom SSD/HDD cage, very easy to do so but just something to note. I did buy two more fans for the bottom of the case (right above where the PSU sits) and could not figure out how to screw them in. Ended up using zip ties to mount the fans but not a huge issue at all and probably something I missed. I have never heard of MUSETEX before this case but their first impression has been stellar! Would strongly recommend this case if you want preinstalled fans, a lightweight case that can hold an ATX board, and is easy on the wallet.
reviews.author: Nathaniel K.

reviews.title: Excellent case
reviews.comment:
The media could not be loaded.  https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/E1JNAyz9w1L.mp4 https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/51xpD6MsTAL._SY256.jpg Leave me alone about my cable management it's my first computer build :(
Easy to build in , excellent cable routing options, plenty of room for oversized graphics cards, fans are great so far but have that silly 6 pin connector and are daisy chained together for both power and RGB, but addressable at least. Case is sturdy and feels top quality, at least to someone who has never built a computer before. Also, airflow is fantastic, though I do remove the top dust filter for gaming as it impedes airflow when the fans are spinning faster than idle. Even has a fancy little window for an RGB power supply or one with a screen, and even has a bottom air intake and filter for the power supply portion.
reviews.author: Alex G

reviews.title: Premium case, but does not fit 3 fan GPU'S well.
reviews.comment: The media could not be loaded.  https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/E1WSKKxjHFL.mp4 https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/91Ka9CwR1CL._SY256.jpg It's an absolute beast of a case and very easy to hook up to the motherboard. After everything's installed it is a heavy PC. (Factor in dedicated GPU or not, I installed Rx 7900XT) Only issue I ran into is the dimensions stated for the GPU weren't exactly as advertised. With the given information, I should have been able to install my Rx7900XT GPU no problem. This was not the case. I had to completely disassemble the backboard of the case to get the GPU to fit inside and hook it up to the 16 pcie connector, but it is an extremely TIGHT SQUEEZE. This added an hour of labor to my build and after all was said and done and put back together, it runs great and combined with the ASUS B650 ATX Motherboard, an AM5 processor, 5.0 Gen SSD, it runs like lightning. Had no problem syncing RGB lighting for all fans. Fits up to a 1000w Corsair PSU. If you plan on installing a larger 3 fan GPU, I suggest going with a LARGEA CASE instead of medium. It will save you an unnecessary headache
reviews.author: Bradley

reviews.title: Super Impressed With Customer Service!!
reviews.comment:
I purchased my first Musetex case for a pc build i was doing for a friend, I loved everything about the case! It is very light but sturdy, cable management is awesome, first pc that I was able to create a show quality PC with no effort, everything is slotted and tabbed in the absolute perfect spot for an atx case. The fans are super quiet and the rgb fans are just amazing! Super stylish for an amazing price!
I was jealous, and decided to purchace a case for myself and when I received the case, the side panel was badly damaged from delivery. I sent Musetex a message thru amazon explaining the situation and they responded within a few hours and said they would replace the side panel no problem. The very next day they sent me a complete replacement case!
Outstanding customer care!
In general, the case is rubust yet light, equipment runs very cool, fans have yet to ramp up at all under load, very sleek case for the price!
Only issue I had upgrading one PC running a Noctua nh-u14s fan was the door barely closed and would sometimes pop open due to fan height. I upgraded to a closed loop aio water cooler that was cheaper than the fan and the entire pc runs even cooler yet! (water cooler is the only way to go now these days, and looks 10x cleaner, and runs cooler)
So glad I didnt spend 2x the price on one of the other "popular" brands! - Customer for life! Thank You Musetex!
reviews.author: Tom
